response: The `run` method in the `TMonitor` class is designed to monitor and manage multiple tqdm progress bars. It continuously checks if any of these progress bars have been inactive for longer than their specified maximum interval (`maxinterval`). If a progress bar has not updated within this time, it temporarily bypasses its minimum iteration interval (`miniters`) to force an update. This ensures that the progress bar remains responsive and provides up-to-date information even when the underlying process is slow or paused. The method uses threading to periodically check the status of all registered tqdm instances without blocking the main program execution. It also handles graceful shutdown by checking a kill signal (`was_killed`) and exiting cleanly if set.
